fire_when: The retrieved DHHoXu 2019 card or a proof uses its categorical anti-concentration/variance nonimplication.
silent_when: A claim gives no fixed positive tail probabilities or discusses only the converse implication from variance to anti-concentration.
text: Check the quantifiers. DHHoXu 2019 Thm 1 is on Z^2 under (1.2.1): two fixed-probability quantiles separated by c sqrt(log n) imply Var>=c' log n when finite. This does not prove a power-law FPP exponent.
